crossRefs.note: They have now surrounded us in our steps. They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.
Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.
They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.
Shimei said when he cursed, “Be gone, be gone, you man of blood, and wicked fellow!
Yahweh has returned on you all the blood of Saul’s house, in whose place you have reigned! Yahweh has delivered the…
Ephraim surrounds me with falsehood, and the house of Israel with deceit. Judah still strays from God, and is…
For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.
For they don’t speak peace, but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.
For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience…
I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me!
Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies…
Jonathan spoke good of David to Saul his father, and said to him, “Don’t let the king sin against his servant, against…
for he put his life in his hand, and struck the Philistine, and Yahweh worked a great victory for all Israel. You saw…
He said, “Why does my lord pursue his servant? For what have I done? What evil is in my hand?
Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David’s counselor, from his city, even from Giloh, while he was offering the…
If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now they have seen and…
But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’

translations.web: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.
translations.bsb: They surround me with hateful words and attack me without cause.
translations.kjv: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.
translations.asv: They have compassed me about also with words of hatred, And fought against me without a cause.
